newsitem.title: JAPAN: THK says it, Paribas in row over three bln yen fund. [CORRECTED 10:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: THK says it, Paribas in row over three bln yen fund. [CORRECTED 10:40 GMT]

text.p: Japan's THK Co, a maker of linear motion systems, said on Thursday that it and Paribas Asset Management Japan Ltd were in a dispute over a three billion yen fund it purchased last year.
(Corrects headline and text to make clear fund valued at three billion yen, not 30 billion yen)

THK said in a statement that the fund, which it bought in November, was to be invested in Italian government bonds, but that Paribas switched the investment target without THK's permission and bought 856,000 shares in TDF Corp.

The fund suffered a loss resulted from recent sharp drop in the shares. THK said it would demand Paribas, a unit of Paribas Asset Management S.A, compensate it for the loss. It did not give any loss estimate.
An officials of Paribas Asset Management Japan, a unit of Paribas Asset Management SA, said the company was investigating into the case and declined to comment further.
